    //==
    // # Signed distance and membership queries
    //
    // Bodies for the implicit interfaces declared in `implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`:
    // the inside / outside / boundary surface a signed distance field induces, and
    // the matching membership surface for predicate-only regions and volumes.

    //==
    // # ISignedDistanceField2D
    //
    // A planar SDF: value is the signed distance to a boundary curve, negative
    // inside. The rich inside/outside/boundary surface builds on that one scalar
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signed_distance_function).

    // The signed distance from the point to the boundary; a readable spelling of
    // Eval. Negative inside, zero on the boundary, positive outside.
    DistanceAt(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Eval(point);

    // The unsigned distance from the point to the boundary: the magnitude of the
    // signed distance.
    ClearanceAt(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Eval(point).Abs;

    // True when the point is strictly inside the boundary (negative distance).
    IsInside(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point) < 0.0;

    // True when the point is strictly outside the boundary (positive distance).
    IsOutside(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point) > 0.0;

    // True when the point lies on the boundary curve within the given tolerance.
    // Precondition: tolerance is non-negative.
    IsOnBoundary(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point).Abs <= tolerance;

    // True when the point is inside or exactly on the boundary (distance <= 0):
    // the closed-region membership test.
    Contains(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point) <= 0.0;

    // How far the point lies inside the boundary: positive within, zero or
    // negative outside. The negated signed distance.
    PenetrationDepthAt(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Eval(point).Negative;

    //==
    // # ISignedDistanceField3D
    //
    // A spatial SDF: value is the signed distance to a surface, negative inside.
    // Mirrors the planar inside/outside/surface surface.

    // The signed distance from the point to the surface; a readable spelling of
    // Eval. Negative inside, zero on the surface, positive outside.
    DistanceAt(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Eval(point);

    // The unsigned distance from the point to the surface: the magnitude of the
    // signed distance.
    ClearanceAt(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Eval(point).Abs;

    // True when the point is strictly inside the surface (negative distance).
    IsInside(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point) < 0.0;

    // True when the point is strictly outside the surface (positive distance).
    IsOutside(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point) > 0.0;

    // True when the point lies on the surface within the given tolerance.
    // Precondition: tolerance is non-negative.
    IsOnSurface(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point).Abs <= tolerance;

    // True when the point is inside or exactly on the surface (distance <= 0):
    // the closed-solid membership test.
    Contains(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point) <= 0.0;

    // How far the point lies inside the surface: positive within, zero or
    // negative outside. The negated signed distance.
    DepthBelowSurfaceAt(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Eval(point).Negative;

    //==
    // # IImplicitRegion2D
    //
    // A planar region defined by a membership predicate; carries no distance.
    // Naming aligns with the SDF surface: Contains / IsInside / IsOutside.

    // True when the point is inside the region; a readable spelling of Eval.
    Contains(self: IImplicitRegion2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point);

    // True when the point is inside the region. Alias of Contains aligning with
    // the signed-distance-field vocabulary.
    IsInside(self: IImplicitRegion2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point);

    // True when the point is outside the region.
    IsOutside(self: IImplicitRegion2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point).Not;

    //==
    // # IImplicitVolume3D
    //
    // A spatial volume defined by a membership predicate; carries no distance.
    // Naming aligns with the SDF surface: Contains / IsInside / IsOutside.

    // True when the point is inside the volume; a readable spelling of Eval.
    Contains(self: IImplicitVolume3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point);

    // True when the point is inside the volume. Alias of Contains aligning with
    // the signed-distance-field vocabulary.
    IsInside(self: IImplicitVolume3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point);

    // True when the point is outside the volume.
    IsOutside(self: IImplicitVolume3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Eval(point).Not;

    //==
    // # Constant and function-valued field algebra
    //
    // Bodies for the constant fields of `fields.types.plato` and the
    // function-valued fields of `fields.types.plato`, plus the combinator
    // algebra over them: lifting any field interface implementor into stored-function
    // form, pointwise composition, and constructive solid geometry on distance
    // fields. Every combinator returns a NEW field holding the composed lambda.

    //==
    // # Constant fields
    //
    // The trivial fields: the same value at every point. Their evaluation ignores
    // the position entirely, which is what makes them the neutral leaves of a
    // field expression.

    // The constant value, at every point of the plane.
    Eval(self: ConstantScalarField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Value;

    // The constant value, at every point of space.
    Eval(self: ConstantScalarField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Value;

    // The constant vector, at every point of the plane.
    Eval(self: ConstantVectorField2D, point: Point2D): Vector2D
        => self.Value;

    // The constant vector, at every point of space.
    Eval(self: ConstantVectorField3D, point: Point3D): Vector3D
        => self.Value;
